novel_features.name: insight
novel_features.description: Computed guidance that turns a station pattern or EVA number into plan/fchg/rchg commands.
novel_features.rationale: Operators need a station-to-command map that the raw Timetables spec does not provide.

novel_features.name: health
novel_features.description: GROUP BY counts and percentages over locally synced timetable resources.
novel_features.rationale: Local store insight without another Marketplace call.

novel_features.name: coverage
novel_features.description: Coverage of expected station/fchg/rchg/plan slices in the local store.
novel_features.rationale: Shows which timetable slices are still missing after sync.

novel_features.name: stale
novel_features.description: Freshness insight for synced timetable slices versus a stale-after budget.
novel_features.rationale: Marketplace quota makes it important to know when local data is old.
